answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation: an agent must lock a refundable stake and slowly build a public record of attested jobs before it can take paid work, like a harbor that only shelters ships with a proven log. A sybil swarm is ivory-white on the surface, thousands of fresh identities with no history, but each one must cross the same bridge of stake and waiting time. Buyers pay only agents whose record shows sustained work, so cloning identities costs more in locked stake than it can ever earn.
